human_substantive_critiques.issue: Unfair/circular ambiguity comparison between BLASTX/DIAMOND (defined at single-protein level with max_target_seqs = 1) and kMermaid (defined at protein cluster level)
Unmotivated two-step CD-HIT clustering pipeline (65% identity on 43K proteins in Step 1 and 70% on 1.79M proteins in Step 2) and lack of comparison to established orthology resources (KEGG/eggNOG)
Need for realistic benchmark on novel/unseen taxa absent from the underlying RefSeq reference database
Clarification of k-mer frequency definition (whether frequencies can exceed 1 when a k-mer appears multiple times in a protein) and mathematical notation in the scoring formula
Justification for the 2 GB RAM cap and comparison against DIAMOND's tunable memory-scaling parameters

ai_only_critical_catches: Unnormalized additive scoring across all pooled non-stop six-frame translations, which injects out-of-frame translation noise and causes linear read-length score inflation (explaining why score cutoffs had to be raised from >3 to 6.3-8.0 in the unseen 2025 RefSeq benchmark and why accuracy degrades for reads >500 nt)

Severe selection bias in the unseen 2025 RefSeq AUROC calculation (0.93-0.96), which was conditioned exclusively on the ~12-14% intersection of reads classified by both BLASTX and kMermaid while excluding ~86% of simulated reads
Coarse step-function SLURM OOM job-crash method used to measure peak RAM usage and manual Linux date command used for runtime timing, plus failure to tune DIAMOND's --block-size parameter
Implausibility of 99.77% (1,793,361 / 1,797,426) of RefSeq microbial proteins clustering into just 32,308 representatives at 70% sequence identity

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Overstated original title and framing ('A Model of Host Adaptive Evolution to Viral Pathogens') given that inter-species divergence and domestic pig patterns have alternative explanations
Clarification of whether 'three independent replicates' in Fig 1 meant qPCR technical replicates or independent infection experiments/wells
Missing PCR and Sanger sequencing validation figures for the CRISPR-Cas9 edited PK15 clones
Omission of continuous European wild boar introgression into free-range Iberian pigs as a key explanation for high Hap2 frequency in Iberian pigs

ai_only_critical_catches: Fundamental population-genetic confounding in the domestic pig positive selection test (Tables 2-3): conditioning on homozygosity for a recently derived focal SNP (Cys/Cys, Hap1) within the same 675 bp non-recombining coding region trivially yields near-zero haplotype diversity even under neutrality, while pooling European and Asian breeds in the ancestral Arg/Arg group induces a strong Wahlund effect (G_is = 0.439)

Non-standard manual genotyping of 751 public ENA raw sequencing datasets by aligning reads to a 675 bp transcript via web NCBI BLAST and visually calling genotypes in a multi-sequence alignment viewer without read-depth or base-quality thresholds

Incomplete reporting of PAML CODEML M8 vs M7 parameters (omitting p1, omega_s > 1, and Bayes Empirical Bayes posterior probabilities in Table 4, plus overlapping species counts 22 + 16 + 10 = 48 > 40)
Missing GenBank accession number for the newly sequenced complete PCV2d isolate genome and lack of protein-level Western blot confirmation of SYNGR2 knockout

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Arbitrary PRS p-value and LD r^2 thresholds, low MAF (<10%) of top SNPs in Table 2, low GWAS statistical power (only 1 genome-wide significant SNP after revision), and request for genomic inflation lambda, heritability estimates, Manhattan plot, and imputation details
Lack of significant HLA mismatch signal in the GWAS and need to adjust for HLA mismatch
Missing public code repository for the GWAS and PRS analysis scripts

ai_only_critical_catches: Biologically contradictory negative weights (beta < 0) in the IBS mismatch PRS (Table 2, e.g., rs12798364 beta = -0.887, rs190087598 beta = -1.068) combined with a symmetric |D_ij - R_ij| metric, meaning donor-recipient genetic mismatches at negative-weight loci actively subtract from the calculated acute rejection risk score

Unadjusted confounding by donor-recipient pedigree relatedness (kinship/pIBD) in living-donor kidney pairs (mixing first-degree relatives and unrelated pairs without adjusting for genome-wide kinship in the Cox model), plus the implausible claim that only 6 of 352 living-donor pairs in GEN-03 had kinship coefficient < 0.1
Invalid application of GCTA-GREML to pairwise |D_ij - R_ij| mismatch scores on a censored time-to-event outcome in a mixed-relatedness cohort to claim an acute rejection heritability of 0.53

LD clumping failure in Table 2, where two PIWIL2 SNPs on Chr 8 only 29.4 kb apart (rs6557986 and rs60263168) with identical MAF (0.084 vs 0.083) and mean IBS (0.051 vs 0.052) both survived a 200 kb / r^2 < 0.2 clumping step

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Restriction of all experiments to the insect-vector epimastigote stage rather than mammalian infective stages (trypomastigotes/amastigotes)

Missing experimental details in Methods (exact concentrations of Bz, Nfx, and resazurin/alamarBlue; whether drugs were pure standards or extracted from tablets; separation of G418/puromycin CRISPR selection vs Bz pressure; kit catalog numbers; justification of |log2FC| > 0.58)

ai_only_critical_catches: Underpowered RNA-seq sample size (n = 2 biological replicates for 61R_cl4 vs n = 3 for 61S) and conflation of 5 paired-end biological libraries with 'Ten paired-end samples' (10 FASTQ files) in Methods Line 62

Poly-A selection technical artifact: libraries were prepared with a poly-A tail enrichment kit, yet non-polyadenylated structural ribosomal RNAs (LSU-srRNA1, LSU-srRNA2, LSU-alpha, LSU-beta) are highlighted as the top downregulated genes in Fig 2C
Absence of any internal housekeeping loading control or total protein stain normalization in the NTRI Western blot (Line 52, S3A Fig)

Confounding of differential expression (e.g., upregulation of DNA replication genes CDC45, RAD51, TOP3) by the much faster proliferation rate of 61R_cl4 (23 h vs 35 h doubling time) and potential chromosomal aneuploidy/CNVs in T. cruzi, with zero functional or RT-qPCR validation of candidate non-NTRI genes

Inaccurate description of human scRNA-seq biopsy datasets from pediatric functional GI disorders and colorectal cancer margins as 'non-diseased'
Need to discuss the cellular source of colonic Lyz1 transcript upregulation and reconcile null individual DEGs with positive Paneth GSEA enrichment

Potential cage-effect confounding in 16S rDNA microbiome analysis due to group-housing mice segregated by genotype (Cre+ vs Cre-) from weaning (Line 161)
Mislabeled statistical test in Fig 5E caption (attributing Bray-Curtis beta-diversity PERMANOVA R^2 = 0.25679, p = 0.003 to an 'unpaired parametric t-test')

Speculative and biologically implausible claim that vascular endothelial cells (VECs) participate in 'visual perception / response to light stimulus' pathways

Fatal population-genetic design flaw in Tables 3-5: pooling two distinct species (Camellia taliensis and Camellia sinensis var. assamica) inside four of the five geographic 'populations' (DL, BS, PE each having n=2 C. taliensis + n=1 C. sinensis var. assamica, vs LC having n=7 C. taliensis + n=1 C. sinensis), which artificially inflates diversity in the 3-tree groups and manufactures the claimed 'genetic erosion' in LC
